name: pixel-pets
description: Pixel-art pets above the prompt that react to what Claude and each subagent are doing

pet.title: Pet
pet.description: Which pet to show. Pick custom to use your own pack, named in Custom pet

customPet.title: Custom pet
customPet.description: Your own pack when Pet is custom: the name of a file in ~/.claude/pets/, without .json

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the pet's labels. auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then $LANG

awakeMinutes.title: Awake minutes
awakeMinutes.description: How long the pet stays awake, strolling around, after Claude finishes, before it falls asleep

labelLine.title: Label line
labelLine.description: Show Claude's line above the pet, with what it is doing and what the pet says. Off, the band is one row shorter
